name: s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::*/* (all objects, all buckets) must warn
note: S1-dataexfil-arn regression: resourceIsBroad() previously treated only the bare '*' (or NotResource) as broad, so a bulk object read scoped to the ARN-wildcard arn:aws:s3:::*/* returned findings=[] status complete exit 0 CLEAN - a DATA-EXFIL fail-open (threat-model T8). An ARN whose bucket-name head is '*' spans every object in every bucket, exactly as broad as Resource:'*', so DATA-EXFIL must fire and the CLI must exit non-zero. GetObject is a read verb, so WILDCARD-RESOURCE must NOT fire.
